description: Synthetic sesslint.checks.ordering parity (stdlib-only vectors; no session payload text).
known_parity_gaps: A real violation calls make_finding with the fingerprint omitted. Rust returns FINGERPRINT_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE. Python emits one SL008 finding. Do not require the two-second edge with skew 0 as a silent vector.
A second violating edge updates count and max_delta_ms on the aggregate finding; that path is also a finding on the Python side.
Python bool is not an int: type(True) is bool is rejected for timestamp_skew_ms. Rust uses Option<i64>, so a bool skew is not represented.
No chrono: a timestamp form the hand parser cannot read is skipped, matching Python ValueError inside _parse_ts.
